content.short: Megaton Finance is an AMM-based DEX on TON that provides yield farming and cross-chain asset swaps.
content.description: Megaton Finance is an AMM-based decentralized exchange on the TON blockchain, developed by the team behind Orbit Bridge. It offers a comprehensive suite of DeFi services, including token swaps, liquidity pools, and lucrative yield farming opportunities. A key advantage of Megaton Finance is its robust cross-chain connectivity, enabling the seamless transfer and trading of assets from other major blockchains like Ethereum and Polygon into the TON ecosystem, thereby boosting liquidity and utility for all users.
